home.hero_title: See your renovation before you start
home.hero_body: Scan your room with your phone or measure it by hand. SlimRuimte builds an accurate floor plan, shows your new kitchen or bathroom in 3D, and connects you with verified contractors in the Netherlands and Belgium.
home.no_card: Free to try · No credit card required
home.value1_desc: Scan your room or measure manually. Accurate to 2 cm.
home.value2_desc: See your new kitchen or bathroom before you start.
home.value3_desc: Three verified contractors receive your visual brief.
home.closing_signed_in: Pick up where you left off and start your next project.
home.closing_signed_out: Create an account and start your first project. All you need is your phone and ten minutes.
